title: dzup-ui component ownership manifest
description: Generated, deterministic statement of which package and subpath owns each exported symbol, and what that symbol is. Produced by packages/tooling/src/ownership/generate-ownership-manifest.ts. Never hand-edited.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema. Core and Pro must agree on the major before their manifests can be merged.

tier.description: Which tier generated the file. A Core checkout can only produce 'core'.

sourceCommit.description: Repository HEAD at generation time, or 'unknown' outside a git checkout. Provenance only -- excluded from the freshness diff.

generatedFrom.description: Authority paths/globs the entries were derived from, sorted.

entries.description: One entry per exported symbol, sorted by symbol with a locale-independent comparator.

anatomy.description: Declared styling surface (ADR-19), copied from the component's Dz{Name}.anatomy.ts. Absent when the component has not declared one.

parts.description: Addressable nodes emitted as data-part. 'none' means the component renders no element of its own -- NOT that its parts are undeclared.

states.description: data-state values plus presence-only boolean state attributes.

optionalParts.description: Parts that may render zero or many times. Every other declared part must appear exactly once.

parentComponent.description: Required for compound-part. Must itself be a public-component in this manifest.

aliasOf.description: Required for compat-alias. Must name a symbol that exists in this manifest.

evidence.description: Authority paths that justified the classification; for unclassified entries, the reason no authority applied.
